================================================================================
USER STORY 001
Epic: Menu
Story ID: US-001

TITLE
View menu items with key details

USER STORY
As a website visitor
I want to view the list of food items with their name, price, and image
So that I can decide what to order.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA
Given I am on the Menu Page
When the menu loads
Then I can see food items displayed with name, price, and image.

Given food items are available
When I scroll the Menu Page
Then I can continue viewing additional items in the menu list.

FIELDS
• Food item name
• Food item price
• Food item image

VALIDATIONS
• Each displayed item must show a non-empty name
• Each displayed item must show a price value
• Each displayed item must show an image

================================================================================
USER STORY 002
Epic: Cart
Story ID: US-002

TITLE
Add menu items to cart

USER STORY
As a website visitor
I want to add a selected food item to my cart
So that I can build my order before checkout.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA
Given I am on the Menu Page
When I add a food item to the cart
Then the item appears in the Cart Page.

Given I have already added an item to the cart
When I add the same item again
Then the item quantity in the cart increases.

FIELDS
• Selected food item
• Cart items
• Item quantity

VALIDATIONS
• Added item must be a valid menu item
• Item quantity in cart must be at least 1

================================================================================
USER STORY 003
Epic: Cart
Story ID: US-003

TITLE
View cart contents and total price

USER STORY
As a website visitor
I want to view the items in my cart and the total price
So that I can understand what I am about to purchase.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA
Given I have items in my cart
When I open the Cart Page
Then I can see the list of items currently in my cart.

Given I have items in my cart
When I view the Cart Page
Then I can see the total price for all items in the cart.

FIELDS
• Cart items
• Total price

VALIDATIONS
• Total price must reflect the current cart contents and quantities

================================================================================
USER STORY 004
Epic: Cart
Story ID: US-004

TITLE
Remove items from cart

USER STORY
As a website visitor
I want to remove an item from my cart
So that I can correct my order before placing it.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA
Given I have an item in my cart
When I remove that item
Then the item no longer appears in the cart.

Given I remove an item from my cart
When I view the Cart Page
Then the total price updates to reflect the removed item.

FIELDS
• Cart items
• Total price

VALIDATIONS
• Removing an item must not affect other cart items

================================================================================
USER STORY 005
Epic: Cart
Story ID: US-005

TITLE
Change item quantity in cart

USER STORY
As a website visitor
I want to change the quantity of an item in my cart
So that I can order the correct number of items.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA
Given I have an item in my cart
When I increase the quantity of the item
Then the cart shows the updated quantity and updated total price.

Given I have an item in my cart
When I decrease the quantity of the item
Then the cart shows the updated quantity and updated total price.

FIELDS
• Item quantity
• Total price

VALIDATIONS
• Quantity must be at least 1 for an item to remain in the cart

================================================================================
USER STORY 006
Epic: Navigation
Story ID: US-006

TITLE
Navigate through the ordering pages

USER STORY
As a website visitor
I want to move between the Menu Page, Cart Page, Checkout Page, and Confirmation Page
So that I can complete the ordering flow from selection to confirmation.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA
Given I am on the Menu Page
When I choose to view my cart
Then I am taken to the Cart Page.

Given I am on the Cart Page
When I proceed to checkout
Then I am taken to the Checkout Page.

Given I place an order from the Checkout Page
When the order is accepted
Then I am taken to the Confirmation Page.

FIELDS
• Menu Page
• Cart Page
• Checkout Page
• Confirmation Page

VALIDATIONS
• Confirmation Page must be reachable only after placing an order

================================================================================
USER STORY 007
Epic: Checkout
Story ID: US-007

TITLE
Enter checkout details

USER STORY
As a website visitor
I want to enter my name, phone number, and address during checkout
So that the order can be prepared and delivered to the right person and location.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA
Given I am on the Checkout Page
When I enter my name, phone number, and address
Then the entered values are captured for the order.

FIELDS
• Customer name
• Phone number
• Address

VALIDATIONS
• Name must not be empty
• Phone number must not be empty
• Address must not be empty

================================================================================
USER STORY 008
Epic: Checkout
Story ID: US-008

TITLE
Place an order from checkout

USER STORY
As a website visitor
I want to place my order from the Checkout Page
So that my cart items and details are submitted as an order.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA
Given I am on the Checkout Page and my cart has at least one item
When I place the order
Then the order is submitted using my cart contents and checkout details.

Given I place the order successfully
When the submission completes
Then I am shown a confirmation that the order was placed.

FIELDS
• Cart items
• Customer name
• Phone number
• Address

VALIDATIONS
• An order cannot be placed if the cart is empty
• An order cannot be placed if name, phone number, or address is empty

================================================================================
USER STORY 009
Epic: Confirmation
Story ID: US-009

TITLE
Show order placed message

USER STORY
As a website visitor
I want to see the message "Order placed successfully"
So that I know my order was completed.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA
Given my order has been placed successfully
When I arrive on the Confirmation Page
Then I see the message "Order placed successfully".

FIELDS
• Confirmation message

VALIDATIONS
• The message text must exactly match: Order placed successfully

================================================================================
USER STORY 010
Epic: Confirmation
Story ID: US-010

TITLE
View order summary on confirmation

USER STORY
As a website visitor
I want to view an order summary after placing an order
So that I can confirm what I ordered and the total price.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA
Given my order has been placed successfully
When I view the Confirmation Page
Then I can see an order summary of the items and quantities.

Given my order has been placed successfully
When I view the Confirmation Page
Then I can see the total price included in the order summary.

FIELDS
• Order summary items
• Item quantities
• Total price

VALIDATIONS
• Order summary must reflect the cart contents at the time the order was placed

================================================================================
USER STORY 011
Epic: Authentication
Story ID: US-011

TITLE
Sign up for a new account

USER STORY
As a new website visitor
I want to create an account by providing my details
So that I can log in and access the main page to place orders.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA
Given I am on the Sign Up Page
When I enter a valid name, email address, and password and submit the form
Then my account is created successfully.

Given my account is created successfully
When the registration completes
Then I am redirected to the Login Page to sign in with my new credentials.

Given I enter an email address that is already registered
When I submit the sign up form
Then I see an error message indicating the email is already in use.

FIELDS
• Full name
• Email address
• Password
• Confirm password

VALIDATIONS
• Full name must not be empty
• Email address must be in a valid email format
• Email address must not already be registered
• Password must not be empty
• Password must meet minimum length requirements
• Confirm password must match the entered password

================================================================================
USER STORY 012
Epic: Authentication
Story ID: US-012

TITLE
Log in to access the main page

USER STORY
As a registered user
I want to log in with my email and password
So that I can access the main page and start ordering.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA
Given I am on the Login Page
When I enter a valid registered email and correct password and submit the form
Then I am authenticated successfully and redirected to the main page.

Given I am on the Login Page
When I enter an unregistered email or an incorrect password
Then I see an error message indicating the credentials are invalid.

Given I have not completed signup
When I attempt to access the main page directly
Then I am redirected to the Login Page.

Given I am successfully logged in
When I arrive on the main page
Then I can see the menu and begin building my order.

FIELDS
• Email address
• Password

VALIDATIONS
• Email address must not be empty
• Email address must be in a valid email format
• Password must not be empty
• Access to the main page must be restricted to authenticated users only
• Invalid credentials must not reveal whether the email or password was incorrect
